instruction: Set up Thunderbird to ensure messages are not removed from the server when deleted or transferred to local folders.

metadata.explanation: Task requires configuring Thunderbird to keep messages on the server even after local deletion or moving. The evaluator checks that mail.server.server1.delete_model is set to 1 (move to trash but keep on server) and mail.server.server1.delete_by_age_from_server is false (don't auto-delete old messages). Also verifies delete_model is not 0 (which would delete from server). Uses existing check_thunderbird_prefs metric function.
metadata.similarity_to_original: high - same application, similar configuration complexity with multiple related settings

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly fetches Thunderbird prefs.js file from VM using get_vm_file
Postconfig appropriately closes Thunderbird to ensure preferences are flushed to disk before verification
Metric check_thunderbird_prefs correctly parses prefs.js and validates expect/unexpect rules
Expected values semantically correct: delete_model=1 (keep on server when deleting locally) and delete_by_age_from_server=false (don't auto-delete)
Unexpect rule correctly prevents delete_model=0 (which would delete from server immediately)
Type compatibility: get_vm_file returns Union[Optional[str], List[Optional[str]]], metric handles None case correctly (returns 0.0)

Minor semantic concern: Instruction mentions 'keep them on the server when I move them to local folders' - the checked settings (delete_model, delete_by_age_from_server) primarily control deletion behavior, though in Thunderbird they may also affect move behavior. The evaluator assumes delete_model settings apply to both delete and move operations.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider verifying if additional Thunderbird preferences like 'mail.server.server1.leave_on_server' exist and should be checked to explicitly cover the 'move to local folders' scenario mentioned in the instruction

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
